name: Customer testimonial (portrait)
description: A customer review on screen: a star rating, the customer’s words in a warm serif, their name and an initials avatar, plus your overall score. For shop windows, showrooms, reception desks and waiting areas. Portrait 9:16 layout.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: quote
params.label: Testimonial
params.help: The customer’s words, without quotation marks. Up to about 220 characters; shorter reads better.
params.default: They fitted our whole kitchen in four days, left the house spotless and came back a week later just to check every drawer still closed properly. We have already sent two neighbours their way.

params.name: detail
params.label: Customer detail
params.help: What they bought, where they are from, or "Verified customer".

params.name: show_score
params.label: Show the overall score
params.help: Off hides the big score and its caption.

params.name: score
params.label: Overall score
params.help: Your average rating, e.g. 4.9. Use a real figure.

params.name: show_logo
params.label: Show the logo
params.help: Off hides the logo and its space stays empty.

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: A PNG or SVG with a transparent background. The placeholder is white for the coloured panel (landscape) or dark for the page (portrait).

params.name: accent
params.label: Accent colour
params.help: The side panel (landscape) or bottom panel (portrait), the avatar and the small heading.

params.name: background
params.label: Background colour
params.help: The page. The avatar initials are drawn in this colour too.
